title: Visio drawings (.vsdx)
summary: Each drawing page is a page, drawn as an image.

items.text: Pages: --page N (from 1) and --all-pages; 'canvasnet info' lists the page names. --dpi must be a whole number.
Shape trees with Master and MasterShape and StyleSheet inheritance: fills, strokes, and text.
1-D connectors with arrowheads and glue, and nested groups.
The built-in color palette, themed colors, and line and fill transparency; NonPrinting and HideText are honored.
PolylineTo, NURBSTo, and spline rows, drawn as flattened line segments.
These are left out or approximated and reported; the page is still drawn, and --strict turns the first report into an unsupported-feature error:
Embedded images and foreign shapes.
Theme Quick Style variation matrices: a themed color that cannot be resolved is drawn neutral gray.
Non-solid fill patterns and gradients, and the full table of arrowhead styles.
A malformed geometry row, or a row type such as InfiniteLine, is skipped; <Type> names the row type.
A curve that cannot be evaluated exactly is approximated by a polyline.
The page to draw, counted from 1 (default 1).
Draw every page; for a drawing of more than one page the output must contain {page} or be a directory.
Resolution in dots per inch (default 96, a whole number above 0 and at most {{maxDpi}}).
The color transparency is flattened over (white by default).
Fail with unsupported-feature instead of drawing with an approximation.
Each report is listed in diagnostics[] as {source: vsdx, severity: unsupported, code: <token>}, once per distinct feature per page. With --strict the first report fails with unsupported-feature.
A themed color was drawn neutral gray.
A curve was approximated by a polyline.
A geometry row was skipped.
The approximations listed above, in particular neutral gray for themed colors that cannot be resolved.
Fonts that are not embedded come from the machine, so text can differ between machines.
